# Exact-brand rule R10: official domains checked against RDAP and DNS

*Generated by `scripts/verify_official_domains.py` (2026-10-23).* Decision C3 follow-up. The 18 hits of the Tranco top-100k scan (`reports/exact_brand_scan.md`) and every official domain in `src/shield/links/exact_brands.json` were looked up in the TLD registry's RDAP and in Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS (A and NS records), **only through `shield.core.net`** (host allowlist, https, no redirects, 2 s per call, at most 1 request per second per host, failures retried twice). No site was opened and no address in a DNS answer was contacted; only the registered domain was sent. Rule: same registrant or same nameservers as the brand's official domain -> add to the official list; clearly different -> leave flagged; unclear -> listed for the user. A nameserver match counts only when the nameservers are the brand's own (roblox.com's nspx*, Amazon's amzndns*), or when the registrant organisation names the brand; a shared DNS pool (AWS Route 53, AliDNS, Akamai) is not enough on its own.

## 2. The existing official lists

94 official domains checked. no apex A record: 9; no owner shown (thin registry, redacted, or RDAP unsupported): 65; owner shown by RDAP (registrant organisation): 29; resolves (an A record): 85. Where a registrant organisation is shown it is the brand or its group (State Bank of India, Axis Bank, Union Bank of India, The Federal Bank, AU Small Finance Bank, One97 Communications for Paytm, Department of Posts for India Post, IRCTC, Bundl Technologies for Swiggy, Delhivery for Ecom Express which Delhivery bought, NPCI Bharat BillPay for NPCI / BHIM, Amazon Technologies / Amazon Europe Core for Amazon, Freecharge, Shadowfax, DTDC, YES Bank, Punjab National Bank, Bank of Baroda, HDFC Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank on .bank.in). **No official domain shows a registrant that is a different company.** The doubtful ones:

| Domain | Brand | What the check shows |
|---|---|---|
| `kotakbank[.]com` | Kotak Mahindra Bank | registrar DropCatch.com 1156 LLC (a drop-catch / back-order registrar), created 2017, no owner shown; the bank's site is kotak.com. Looks like a caught expired domain, not the bank's. Recommend removing it from the list. |
| `icicibank[.]bank[.]in` | ICICI Bank | does not exist: DNS NXDOMAIN and RDAP 404. (R10 ignores .bank.in anyway.) Recommend removing it. |
| `axisbank[.]bank[.]in` | Axis Bank | does not exist: DNS NXDOMAIN and RDAP 404. (R10 ignores .bank.in anyway.) Recommend removing it. |
| `onlinesbi[.]com` | State Bank of India | the apex has no A or NS answer in DNS (legacy name; the bank uses onlinesbi.sbi), but the registry delegates it to pdns / sdns.satyam.net.in, the nameservers sbi.co.in uses. Ownership consistent; keep. |
| `paytm[.]me` | Paytm | added after the scan from recognition; RDAP unsupported for .me, resolves (Akamai nameservers, Paytm's other domains use AWS or Akamai). Owner not verified. |
| amazon.eu / amazon.jp | Amazon | added after the scan; RDAP unsupported for .eu and .jp, both resolve and use AWS Route 53 nameservers. Owner not shown by any registry. |
| `amazon[.]dev` | Amazon | apex has no A record (NS only); registrar Com Laude, AWS nameservers. Keep. |
| amazon.de / .it / .es / .se / .co.jp / .com.mx / .ae / .sa / .eg / .com.tr / .com.be / .cn / .co.za / .ie | Amazon | RDAP unsupported for these ccTLDs, so no owner is shown. All resolve; .it, .es, .com.mx and .com.be use Amazon's own amzndns nameservers, the rest AWS Route 53. |
